race.comment: WIND RUSH (5) took over a fair way out and kept going to salute comfortably over 1550m at Bordertown eight days ago. Very effective miler who draws a lovely gate and is sure to be prominent for a long way. SECOND FIX (10) tackled the mile for the first time this prep at Donald last Sunday and was just fair through the line. Drops 4.5kgs after the claim and that last run should have tightened him right up. Genuine contender. STARGUST (11) had been racing in great heart on rain-affected tracks before a mediocre effort on a good surface at Horsham most recently. Would prefer some give in the ground but off a five-week freshen up is worth some thought. FOREVER WAITING (13) closed at a rate of knots to get the prize over 1350m at Strathalbyn last weekend. A definite risk at the mile but with the light weight he cannot be ruled out. RAIKOKE (1) scored effortlessly at Port Lincoln last time. New to this trip but must be considered.
